Grief at Christmas: when is it typical grief, and when has it become stuck?

A first Christmas without someone can be especially hard, and that is often grief doing what grief does. Prolonged grief is less about how much it hurts on one day and more about whether the longing stays at the same pitch for many months. Knowing the difference may make the holidays feel a little less frightening.
